title: Time - The 100 best movies of the past 10 decades - 1970s

movies.overview: A gambler and a prostitute become thriving business partners in a remote Old West mining town until a large corporation arrives on the scene.
movies.title: McCabe & Mrs. Miller
movies.tagline: The story of a gambling man and a hustling lady and the empire they fashioned from the wilderness.

movies.overview: A recently widowed American begins an anonymous sexual relationship with a young Parisian woman.
movies.title: Last Tango in Paris
movies.tagline: When you see a love story, it's only a movie. When you feel it with every nerve in your body, it's a masterpiece.

movies.original_title: Céline et Julie vont en bateau
movies.overview: Julie, a daydreaming librarian, meets Céline, an enigmatic magician, and together they become the heroines of a time-warping adventure involving a haunted house, psychotropic candy, and a murder-mystery melodrama.
movies.title: Céline and Julie Go Boating

movies.overview: A young neurosurgeon inherits the castle of his grandfather, the famous Dr. Victor von Frankenstein. In the castle he finds a funny hunchback, a pretty lab assistant and the elderly housekeeper. Young Frankenstein believes that the work of his grandfather was delusional, but when he discovers the book where the mad doctor described his reanimation experiment, he suddenly changes his mind.
movies.title: Young Frankenstein
movies.tagline: The scariest comedy of all time!

movies.overview: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
movies.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.tagline: The rise and fall of the Corleone empire.

movies.overview: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled shark hunter embark on a desperate quest to kill the beast before it strikes again.
movies.title: Jaws
movies.tagline: The terrifying motion picture from the terrifying No. 1 best seller.

movies.original_title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
movies.overview: A lonely widowed housewife does her daily chores and takes care of her apartment where she lives with her teenage son, and turns the occasional trick to make ends meet. Slowly, her ritualized daily routines begin to fall apart.
movies.title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles

movies.overview: This film documents the coal miners' strike against the Brookside Mine of the Eastover Mining Company in Harlan County, Kentucky in June, 1973. Eastover's refusal to sign a contract (when the miners joined with the United Mine Workers of America) led to the strike, which lasted more than a year and included violent battles between gun-toting company thugs/scabs and the picketing miners and their supportive women-folk. Director Barbara Kopple puts the strike into perspective by giving us some background on the historical plight of the miners and some history of the UMWA.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in partnership with New York Women in Film & Television in 2004.
movies.title: Harlan County U.S.A.

movies.overview: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city.
movies.title: Taxi Driver
movies.tagline: On every street in every city in this country, there's a nobody who dreams of being somebody. He's a lonely forgotten man desperate to prove that he's alive.

movies.overview: An African-American man working at a slaughterhouse in the Watts area of Los Angeles leads a dissatisfied and listless existence.
movies.title: Killer of Sheep
